      "type": "suggestion",

      "text": "mention the reason for the block count as a comment in the test",

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "transaction states may not be fully updated when abandonment happens in the same forward loop",
      "quote": "This doesn't seem entirely correct now because the state of all transactions are not updated due to the following abandon call being present in the same loop that also updates the transaction state.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated to reverse traversal",

      "status_by_id": "rc:3268881059",
      "status_by_quote": "Updated"

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "remove wallet.unloadwallet() from test as best block is written to disk on every block connected notification",
      "quote": "Nit: I don't believe unloading the wallet is necessary because all the blocks contain wallet transaction so the best block will be written to disk on every block connected notification just like unloading the wallet would do.",

      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained unloading is needed to prevent data loss with -unsafesqlitesync",

        "rc:3306370494"

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3306370494",
      "status_by_quote": "Since the tests run with `-unsafesqlitesync`, not all data will be flushed at any given time."
    },

      "id": "rc:3298177014",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add assertions to the test regarding node and wallet height states",
      "quote": "Considering the subtleness of the issue, can we add few assertions here to make it explicit for the reader regarding node/wallet height states?",

      "status_note": "author added the suggested assertions",

      "other_replies": [],

      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "intermittent CI assertion failure in wallet_chain_reprocess.py",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed a fix for the CI test failure",

        "rc:3319980789"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3319980789",
      "status_by_quote": "Hopefully fixed"
    },

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "perform state updates and abandonments in separate passes instead of reverse traversal",
      "quote": "Do we need the reverse traversal here, or could we do the state updates and abandonments in separate passes instead?",

      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained reverse order allows doing both in one pass to avoid iterating large tx sets twice",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3364695281"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3364695281",
      "status_by_quote": "We want to minimize iterating the entire set of transactions since there can be a lot of them, and be very slow."
    },

      "id": "rc:3363818735",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "check that the wallet's processed block caught up to the node tip after restart",
      "quote": "Can we also check that the wallet's processed block has caught back up to the node tip after the restart catch-up path?",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added the assertion",

        "rc:3364702775"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:3364702775",
      "status_by_quote": "Done"
    },

        "rc:3865543227"

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3865543227",
      "status_by_quote": "Leaving this as is. There is also an `EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_HELD` annotation."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3730653984",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add a comment explaining the ordering dependency where updateState runs before rescan",
      "quote": "I think a comment explaining this ordering dependency perhaps would help future readers (?).",

      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "author deferred addressing this",

      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3961915309",
      "status_by_quote": "If I retouch"
    },

      "id": "rc:4067859704",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add a unit test covering the ordering bug since the functional test passes with the fix reverted",
      "quote": "the test still passes with the fix reverted. It's a useful test that covers wallet catch-up, but doesn't distinguish the broken behavior from the fixed behavior",

      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""

      "kind": "correctness",
